epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease backend application container boot and health-check failure rate from 100% to 0% in observed launches
epics.tocConstraintRef: Backend Application Launch and Health Check
requirements: R1: The backend application starts successfully and does not crash on boot.
R2: The backend application responds with HTTP 200 OK to the health check on port 18080.

slices.title: Resolve backend application startup crash to enable successful health checks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to patch the existing startup logic to prevent crash or hang, so that the Application Startup Remediation epic outcome is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment of the backend environment
When the backend container initializes
Then the container must start successfully without exiting early
Given a running backend container
When the health check is polled at /health on port 18080
Then the backend must return a 200 OK response, proving the application is fully up
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease health check /health endpoint failure rate from 100% to 0%
